title: CHECKPOINT payload
description: Merkle root over all preceding event hashes, with tree size, operator signature, and optional external receipt. Emitted periodically (every N events or T_cp).

root.description: SHA-256 Merkle root over the event_hash values of all preceding events in this session.

tree_size.description: Number of events covered by this checkpoint (the tree has this many leaves).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature under the operator key, over canonical JSON of [root, tree_size]. Hex-encoded.

receipt.description: Optional. Receipt from an external append-only transparency log (e.g., SCITT) that anchors this checkpoint.
